problem: A completed useful turn could hit the 12-round ceiling before record_turn_outcome, causing cancellation/hard-disable; aborted turns also left local actual-token accounting at zero despite backend usage.
required_properties: At the work-round ceiling, one non-material grace response instructs the model to call record_turn_outcome instead of cancelling immediately.
Only record_turn_outcome may execute beyond the 12 work-round ceiling.
A repeated post-cap work request still fails closed.
Abort/failure settlement accounts actual cumulative usage when available and conservatively charges the full reservation otherwise.
No idle-driven model submission or budget bypass is introduced.
